fixes.explanation: Right, baker. Look at what verse 3 does: “Whoever slaughters an ox is like one who slays a man…” The offerings are right there, and the LORD still sets them beside things that are awful. Then He says what is going on: “Indeed, they have chosen their own ways and delighted in their abominations.” (Isaiah 66:3). So the offering isn't the whole story, and the verse points to the ways they chose.

That's the one, baker. The LORD says, “…because I called and no one answered, I spoke and no one listened.” (Isaiah 66:4). He called and He spoke, and nobody answered or listened. I think this part is heavy. Then the verse says what they did instead: “But they did evil in My sight and chose that in which I did not delight.”

Nineveh isn't in this passage, baker. The LORD names the mother in the same verse: “Yet as soon as Zion was in labor, she gave birth to her children.” (Isaiah 66:8). It's Zion. In this picture she's the one in labor, and she gives birth to her children as soon as it starts.
